title: Få saker gjorda!
body:
Det här är ett kraftfullt och mysigt verktyg för personlighetstyper som har svårt med igångsättning och planering av sin tid. Eller personer som bara vill ha ett bra planeringsverktyg för små-saker som ”aldrig blir gjorda”. Appen gör det roligt att få saker och ting gjorda, och gör det enkelt att planera in saker man måste göra.

Kommer man på något som måste göras? Bara att lägga det i Inkorgen och planera in det sen. Att man också kan mäta energiåtgång om man vill på ett så enkelt sätt, för att se om det blir för mycket inplanerat under en dag, är också så otroligt användbart. Allt uppdateras utan problem via iCloud så man kan titta i iPad och Mac också om man har möjlighet och vill det. Fokus-funktionen, där man ser hur lång tid det är kvar av en aktivitet, är också en guld-funktion i vissa aktiviteter som känns tråkiga, så att man står ut med att göra klart. Och när man är klar med en uppgift så bockar man av den, den stryks över samtidigt som ett trevligt ljud ploppar till, otroligt tillfredsställande.

Ska man nämna några nackdelar så skulle det vara att appen verkar dra lite mer batteri än andra appar, och att den fortfarande verkar ha en del buggar där jag t.ex. lagt till saker i Inkorgen som inte hamnat där förrän jag startat om appen. Men tillverkarna arbetar hela tiden på uppdateringar, så det kommer dom säkert fixa med tiden.

Det tog några dagar, sedan insåg jag att jag kommer leva med den här appen.

Jag måste rekommendera den här appen å det varmaste om man har en personlighetstyp där man inte får saker och ting gjorda, t.ex. om man har svårt med igångsättning, adhd, add, autism osv. Jag rekommenderar den även som en mer allmän planeringskalender till alla, då med fokus på grejer som ska göras men aldrig blir gjorda. 

Stort tack till tillverkarna av den här appen som har förenklat mitt och många andras liv!

title: Great app!
body:
Structure makes it very easy to create and follow routines! It allows you to plan your day hour by hour, and to keep track on which activities are completed by checking them. You can also make sub-activities to every activity and then check them as well when they are completed, super useful! It’s easy to repeat the different activities on specific days, or make them only appear once. Another function I like is the separate check list with activities that needs to be done, but without deadline. Recently I noticed that you can also decide how energy-demanding different activities on your schedule are, and experiment with how much work/rest you need each day. Great idea!

However, there is also one function I'm missing. While Structured is great for creating routines, it is not very good for getting an overview of more flexible activities coming up within the next month.  So for example, if I create an activity and put it into the schedule that I will study from 8 to 12 each day, I can't switch to an overview of the entire month where I can easily see what “studying” means each day. Like; am I having an exam, a deadline, a meeting, or class? Such a function is crucial when you are planning several weeks ahead and need to see your plans month by month. With such a function Structured would get 5/5 stars from me!

title: Everything works great, except the AI
body:
The app is great and I will still use it for my daily planning, but the AI is useless. It did not take into account the few things I had added to the schedule myself, making it useless since it’s suggestions just asumed I didn’t have any commitments and didn’t plan around them. I tried using it for productivity since I wanted to copy my schedule to the following week so I don’t have to manually tell the tasks to repeat but it didn’t understand those instructions.

Other than that the app is very intuitive and choosing icons and colors helps me a lot when I look at the schedule. It imports my appointments from my iOS calender which is great, and it does this automatically the second I add something (accept an event invite via text etc.). 

It suggests the tasks I have already inputed for other days and editing the time I do them is easy. 

Great app, AI needs a lot of work but I look forward to when it is actually usable.

title: I’m officially Structured !! (only 1 wish request for 5 stars)
body:
This app is just LOVE IT! 
The design is very my kind of style.
It’s so easy and quick to add new task.
It has helped me to take my meds daily.

For someone like me who used to forget their meds for days and sometimes even weeks 🫣 I haven’t missed a single medication or any tasks… or been late to any meetings since I’ve used Structured. It shows how much time you have in between tasks and when I can have a break 💖💖💖

I’ve noticed more icons have been added which I LOVE. Personally, more social media and creator friendly related icons would be nice to have 🤩 All icons currently though works well 💕

I didn’t really need an upgrade to use it but I loved it so much that I made a purchase specifically to support the developer. I’m staying with this app and I know it’ll go far. Seeing that the developer doesn’t have more apps helps me know that they are focused on improving Structured as well as I can see how often they update it 🌟

💌 My request “wish”
Currently I am able to see my calendar events and do minor changes like the icon but in order to make further changes, I’d have to open the actual app. — Please let me create and fully edit calendar events through Structured as well 🙏🏼🌸✨

title: Completely useless without notifications
body:
A task app is completely useless if it does not support notifications, which in this one are a paid feature.

The Reminders and Calendar import functionality is fine being paid features, but notifications are something that's entirely core for an app of this nature.

The same is pretty much true for recurring tasks.

author: Mattias Lind

title: Ticks all my boxes
body:
The perfect productivity app is hard to find and it’s up to personal preferences, which is why I really appreciate when an app developer let’s one customise the look and feel of the app.

An original app, that’s ultra stable, has a clean and consistent design language and is customisable is hard to find… this is very close to perfect for me. 

The first thing that grabbed my attention, and usually the first thing that causes me to instantly delete a newly downloaded app is the stability. Structured is smooth and fast. It feels good to use.

I really hope at some point we see a desktop and Apple Watch version.. 

One feature I’d like to request is, when in the timeline view of the day, the ability to re-order tasks with a simple hold and drag gesture, like with Apple Calendar and Fantastical.. sometimes things get postponed and it’s much easier to drag and re-order your day quickly this way than editing the time of each individual event. 

Great job on this app!
